common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Misplacing the decimal point during multiplication (e.g. 0.2 × 0.3 = 0.6 instead of 0.06).
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Count total decimal places: 0.2 (1 place) + 0.3 (1 place) = 2 places. Thus 0.06.

common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Forgetting to shift the decimal point in dividend when shifting in divisor during division.
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Always multiply BOTH dividend and divisor by the same power of 10 to clear the divisor's decimal.
